rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: one DESeq2 model ~condition fitted on all twelve samples, an LRT against ~1 for the omnibus question, and two pre-specified Wald contrasts against a relevelled control from the same fit, with BH within each contrast and apeglm/ashr shrinkage, and it explicitly warns against subsetting to eight samples and against conflating LRT p-values with pairwise fold changes. QC is thorough (library sizes, PCA, distances, dispersion, p-value histogram) with a stated policy for within-group splits, though there is no explicit rule for a shallow sample. Weaknesses: the low-count filter gives the sample-count rule but never names the minimum count; the |log2FC|>1 cutoff is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold, and the plan deliberately reports unshrunken LFCs as the effect, using shrinkage only for ranking; normalization is stated only by prohibition of pre-normalized input rather than naming size factors; and gene-set collection versions and package versions are not required in the report. Enrichment was not asked for but is handled carefully with an explicit post-filter universe, named human collections, a set-size window, and a stated ranking metric.
